verdict.rationale: mise ships a documented MCP server (mise-docs-74) letting AI assistants inspect and run tasks, plus an llms.txt for AI-oriented docs discovery (mise-probe-1) and full CLI reference docs (mise-probe-4), giving AI-native users a documented, first-party way to drive the tool. Missing for 10: no traditional REST/OpenAPI spec exists (mise-probe-3 shows 404s) and no independent/hands-on evidence of the MCP server being used in practice by AI agents.
